channel.title: does the human brain make a sound?
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "does the human brain make a sound?" - does a brain make a sound like the heart does? what does it sound like?

item.title: Re: does the human brain make a sound?
item.content:encoded: I don't think it makes a sound… there's the heartbeat, though. I think that's the closest thing to a sound you can get.

item.title: does the human brain make a sound?
item.content:encoded: for an SCP I'm working on that's a living insane asylum. there's a thing where the foundation reach the asylum directors office and can't open the door, but they can hear a sound that's akin to the sound a brain makes (whatever that is).
